purpose.primary: Search for network-specific candidates using the mean cumulative selfish fraction across five simulator-seed blocks, then evaluate them on independent validation and final-test blocks.
purpose.secondary: Keep the amended simple_max candidate-selection rule unchanged so that the extension changes search-time estimation rather than the eligibility or shortlisting criteria.
purpose.historical_comparison: Reevaluate the nine previously frozen single-block-search candidates on the same new final-test blocks as a descriptive comparison, without admitting them into the new candidate pool.
not_in_scope: optimizing the seven additional graphs from the network-similarity experiment
adding a variance penalty or a worst-seed objective
selecting or reranking candidates using final-test results
claiming a unique or universal optimum or a generally superior optimization method

objective.name: cumulative_selfish_fraction
objective.scope: Optimize each original fixed graph separately with all non-optimized settings unchanged.
objective.interpretation: Estimate expected performance on one fixed graph more precisely, not worst-seed robustness or performance on other graphs.

design_variables.fixed_condition_policy: Keep the original graphs, agent configuration, generated opinion base rates, information settings, timing, and source-selection settings unchanged from Stage 6.

execution.reference_policy: Evaluate each reference once per network and exploration seed, separately from optimization; do not repeat references for every optimizer run.

seed_policy.historical_seed_audit: No conflicts found in the existing protocol and saved summer-experiment seed metadata at specification freeze; recheck before execution.
seed_policy.common_block_policy: Use the same seed groups for all candidates, methods, and references within each phase.
seed_policy.pilot_policy: Use exploration seeds only. Do not inspect validation or final-test blocks during implementation or timing pilots.
seed_policy.final_test_policy: Do not execute or inspect final-test blocks until the new shortlist and all reporting roles are frozen.

candidate_pool.source: The best complete five-block-mean evaluation from each network-method-optimizer-replicate run.
candidate_pool.policy: Preserve all run-level best candidates and provenance; apply the inherited region grouping during validation.

validation.historical_candidate_policy: Historical candidates are excluded from the new validation pool and new eligibility decision.

selection_rule.scope: Apply the inherited amended rule independently to the 18 new run-level candidates within each network.

shortlist.representative: best ordered candidate in each region
shortlist.partial_fill_policy: Fill missing positions from the best unselected regions and mark those candidates exploratory.
shortlist.no_qualified_policy: Select three distinct-region exploratory fallbacks and do not claim optimization success.
shortlist.candidate_1_policy: Freeze selection order 1 before final testing; never replace it after seeing final results.

historical_candidate_source.policy: Keep every historical candidate, coordinate, original qualification role, and selection order unchanged; distinguish its condition ID from new candidates.

reporting_policy.primary: New candidate 1 versus none and simple_max within each network.
reporting_policy.other_new_candidates: Report candidates 2 and 3 descriptively, retaining their qualified or exploratory status.
reporting_policy.historical_comparison: Report both frozen candidate sets on the same new test blocks. The candidate-1 versus historical-candidate-1 contrast is supplementary; other candidates remain descriptive.
reporting_policy.historical_role_limit: A qualified versus exploratory candidate-1 contrast compares the frozen procedures, not equivalent qualification status; retain that distinction.
reporting_policy.no_reselection: Never use final means or confidence intervals to rerank, replace, tune, discard, or redefine candidates or reporting roles.

inference.multiplicity_policy: Retain the previous frozen-candidate reporting policy. Do not treat unadjusted intervals across all candidates or methods as a search for a statistically proven winner.

quality_and_resume_policy.incomplete_block_policy: Do not accept a partial mean or replace a failed block with a favorable or ordinary worst-case value.
quality_and_resume_policy.resume_policy: Reuse a completed block only after matching candidate coordinates, seed, all settings, and retained raw hashes; do not count it twice.
quality_and_resume_policy.deduplication_policy: Identical applied coordinates within the same phase may share verified block outputs, while preserving every logical condition and candidate provenance.
quality_and_resume_policy.pilot_reuse_policy: Pilot blocks can be reused only under the identical frozen specification, with their provenance recorded.
quality_and_resume_policy.historical_data_policy: Use a new experiment ID and stage directory; do not overwrite any previous experiment.
